about: The Workbench icons of the ClassiCube drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is ClassiCube's own program icon (misc/CCicon.png, brought to 128x128: art/classicube.png). ClassiCube-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, ClassiCube.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's ClassiCube.info. Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (texpacks, maps, screenshots): the Makefile copies it to each name. ReadMe.info serves ReadMe and LICENSE.txt.
